metaDescription: See where your dog plays, rests, and thrives. Our purpose-built daycare facility and private woodland in Fleet & Farnham are designed for safety and enrichment.
heroEyebrow: Where your dog plays, rests and thrives
heroLead: Two distinct spaces designed for your dog's safety and happiness — a purpose-built daycare facility and our private woodland enrichment area.
daycareIntro: Our primary space for day care and boarding is a secure, purpose-built facility designed with your dog's comfort and safety at the heart of everything. Fully licensed and supervised throughout the day by qualified staff, it provides a safe and stimulating environment where dogs can play, rest, and socialise.

daycareFeatures.title: Secure, purpose-built facility
daycareFeatures.text: Enclosed and purpose-designed for dog day care and boarding — safe from the moment your dog arrives.

daycareFeatures.title: Indoor rest and play areas
daycareFeatures.text: Dedicated indoor spaces give dogs somewhere calm to rest and recharge between activity sessions.

daycareFeatures.title: Constant qualified supervision
daycareFeatures.text: Our vet-nurse-led team is present at all times, ensuring every dog receives attentive, expert care.

daycareFeatures.title: Fully licensed and insured
daycareFeatures.text: We hold all required licences and insurance, so you can drop off with complete confidence.

woodlandIntro: Separate from the daycare facility, our private woodland is an added benefit that dogs access during structured walk time. It is not the daycare area — it is a natural enrichment space used for off-road walks and sensory exploration, available to day care and boarding dogs as part of their daily experience.

woodlandFeatures.title: Private, off-road woodland walks
woodlandFeatures.text: Dogs explore a dedicated private woodland — away from public footpaths and other hazards.

woodlandFeatures.title: Sensory stimulation and natural exploration
woodlandFeatures.text: Natural terrain, scents, and variety offer meaningful enrichment that complements their time in the facility.

woodlandFeatures.title: Structured, supervised access
woodlandFeatures.text: Woodland time is always structured and supervised — never unsupervised or free-roaming.

woodlandFeatures.title: Available for day care and boarding dogs
woodlandFeatures.text: Both day care and boarding dogs benefit from woodland enrichment as part of their daily routine.

safetyIntro: Every aspect of our facilities is underpinned by professional qualifications, proper licensing, and a genuine commitment to your dog's welfare.
ctaTitle: Want to see it for yourself?
ctaText: Book a free meet & greet and trial day — no pressure, no cost. Come and see our facilities in person across {areasLabel}.
